note: Macon County, AL has no county zoning (Alabama counties generally lack zoning power). City of Tuskegee's Codes office handles zoning questions but posts no zoning map or ordinance online; its GIS page lists only council district maps (political, not zoning). Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no zoning district layer for Macon County or Tuskegee (only a Tuskegee city/Town & Gown service without zoning, and a Macon 2020 Districts service that requires a token). Shorter and Notasulga have zoning maps per third-party aggregators but no published GIS service was found.
